data.name: Ashes of Creation
data.detailed_description:
State of Alpha

Ashes of Creation is currently in active Alpha testing, which means the game is still deep in development and evolving alongside our community. Many of the systems you will experience - combat, settlements, crafting, caravans, sieges, and more - are works in progress. Some are early prototypes, some are being refined, and others are yet to be fully introduced.

Because of this, players should expect:

  • Frequent updates that may reset progress as we implement major changes.

  • Bugs, performance issues, missing features, and incomplete content across the world of Verra.

  • Active balance adjustments and system reworks based on live player feedback and internal testing.

This stage of development is not just a preview - it’s a partnership with our players.

A COLLABORATIVE DEVELOPMENT PROCESS

We believe MMORPGs are stronger when built with the community, not just for it. During Alpha, we actively engage players through:

  • In-game testing events focused on core pillars like sieges, node progression, raids, caravans, and PvP systems.

  • Official feedback channels via forums, surveys, Discord, livestream Q&As, and direct playtest reports.

  • Transparent development updates where we share progress, showcase new systems, and discuss community-requested changes.

  • Rapid iteration - player feedback from live tests frequently results in system adjustments in the following patches.

Your experiences, both the epic moments and the broken ones, directly shape the future of Verra.

WHAT ALPHA IS (AND ISN’T)
Alpha is:

✔ A chance to help build a world from the ground up.

✔ A place where experimentation is encouraged and feedback matters.
✔ A raw, unpolished view of systems that will grow into the foundation of a living MMORPG.

Alpha is not:

✖ A finished game.

✖ A guarantee of uninterrupted progression, your characters and servers may be wiped.

✖ A fully balanced or content-complete experience.

WHY YOUR PARTICIPATION MATTERS

Every test brings us closer to a world that feels alive, reactive, and player-driven just as we envisioned it. By joining us now, you’re not merely playing a game; you’re helping shape one of the most ambitious MMORPGs in development.

Thank you for your patience, passion, and most of all, your feedback. Together, we’re rebuilding civilization on Verra.


About the Game

A World Reborn from the Ashes

Ashes of Creation is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) set in a high-fantasy world where player actions shape the world itself. Cities rise and fall, populations shift, and entire regions transform as players rebuild civilization on living, reactive continents. Every decision, individual or collective, leaves a lasting mark on the world of Verra.

Whether you’re leading armies into battle, building empires through trade and craftsmanship, or uncovering ancient secrets long buried beneath the sands, Ashes of Creation offers an evolving journey defined by the choices of its players.

Key Features

  • A Living, Breathing World
    Experience a dynamic world that evolves with player activity. Build and defend player-driven cities known as Settlements - each unlocking new content, quests, and political structures as they grow.

  • Risk and Reward PvP & PvE
    Engage in large-scale battles, dungeon raids, and open-world conflicts. Wage war and siege against your enemies, defend trade caravans, or venture into dangerous dungeons where glory and peril go hand in hand.

  • Player-Driven Civilization
    Every realm develops differently. Players influence the growth of settlements, elect mayors, form alliances, and wage wars that reshape the political landscape of Verra.

  • Integral Crafting and Economy Systems
    Gather resources, trade goods, and craft powerful items across a player-driven economy. Control resource routes, establish trade hubs, and profit from your influence, or sabotage your rivals’ Caravan supply lines.

  • Epic Exploration and Adventure:
    Discover a vast, hand-crafted world filled with unique biomes, ancient ruins, and hidden treasures. Mount up and explore the wild frontier- every journey holds the promise of discovery and danger.

  • Boundless Archetype Combinations
    Choose from eight primary archetypes to create your character, customize your skills and abilities. Whether you’re a stealthy Rogue, a commanding Summoner, or a protective Tank, your playstyle will be entirely your own.

  • Massive Warfare
    Join hundreds of players in epic sieges and realm conflicts that decide the fate of nations. Gather resources, and command armies in battles that alter the course of the world.

Your Story, Written by Many

In Ashes of Creation, no two realms or stories are ever the same. The world evolves as players build, explore, and destroy, forging a tapestry of triumph and tragedy that belongs to its community. Will you be a builder of empires, a bringer of chaos, or a legend remembered in song?

The choice and the world is yours to shape.

data.short_description: Ashes of Creation is an old-school take on the modern MMORPG set in a living, reactive world where your choices shape civilization. In this PvX open world sandbox, players will build cities, forge empires, and lay siege to foes. Uncover the Ancients as you fight to reclaim the fallen world of Verra.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i5 8400 | AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Discrete NVIDIA GTX 1070 or equivalent (Integrated GPU is not supported)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 150 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required (Internal SATA/M.2) / May be more than 150GB
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i7 8700 | AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 150 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required (Internal M.2 NVME) / May be more than 150GB
